extractor: src/extract_features.c (kernel headers included read-only; features replicate syz_fused's per-cell reads; fixed sel/tone computed by the kernel's own syz_ste_select4 / syz_fused_tone)
feature_notes: int16; block stats over the cell's 8 luma taps (means round-half-up); features 7,10 are the exact two values the fixed tokenizer scores (green, cell_luma). Micro K=8 uses features 0-7; full K=16 uses all.
record_layout: per cell: 16 x int16 features, uint8 fixed_sel, uint8 fixed_tone_idx; frame-major, row-major
